name: amazon/product
description: Get an Amazon product by ASIN: title, brand, price, rating, reviews, images, variants, availability, purchase options, about-this-item and description.

asin.description: The Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) of the product you want to retrieve. This is a unique identifier assigned to each product on Amazon.

device.description: The device to use to get the results. It can be set to `desktop` (default) to use a regular browser, `tablet` to use a tablet browser (currently using iPads), or `mobile` to use a mobile browser.

language.description: The language to use for the Amazon search. It's a locale name represented as _. (e.g., on amazon.com `en_US` for English, `es_US` for Spanish, or on amazon.co.jp `ja_JP` for Japanese). Head to Amazon languages for a full list of supported Amazon languages.

delivery_zip.description: ZIP Postal code. To filter the shipping products by a selected area.

amazon_domain.description: The Amazon domain to use. It defaults to `amazon.com`. Head to Amazon domains for a full list of supported Amazon domains.

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

shipping_location.description: Shipping country. To filter the shipping products by a selected country.

all_related_products.description: Set to `true` to retrieve all items in `related_products` and `related_product_sections`, not just the first page. May yield better results but with a longer response time. Defaults to `false`.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.
